categories: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths

concerns.quote: The Inquest heard evidence from the Head of Service for Safeguarding and Learning for Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council. She highlighted a long-standing gap in provision, which was described as extending across most if not all local authorities, for vulnerable adults who have complex needs, but who do not fall into the existing framework of social services, Care Act provision or formal mental health supervision.
concerns.hazard: vulnerable adults with complex needs lacking coordinated support

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the absence of a single point of contact or coordinated care for vulnerable adults with complex mental health and social care needs. They differ in that the earlier report concerns a specific individual case, while the later report describes a systemic gap across many local authorities.
links.earlier_quote: no -one saw Matthew as the vulnerable adult he was and addressed how his own complex needs were to be met, either through a Care Act assessment or any other means.
links.later_quote: She highlighted a long-standing gap in provision, which was described as extending across most if not all local authorities, for vulnerable adults who have complex needs, but who do not fall into the existing framework of social services, Care Act provision or formal mental health supervision.
